identifiabilityBarrier.type: Unspecified observation model prevents certified effect-onset identification; not a universal impossibility theorem for video estimation.
identifiabilityBarrier.formalTest: Given pixels Y_k and PTS t_k, define the feasible onset set S={tau: some recording-matched effect/render model, pixel-error realization, timing mapping and semantic/alias branch consistent with all Y_k has onset tau}. Qualification needs sup(S)-inf(S)<=100 PTS units. Retained evidence supplies neither the admissible recording-error/timing family nor verified original effect binding, so that diameter cannot be bounded defensibly.
identifiabilityBarrier.observability: Fading/translation/rotation overlap. Encoded first appearance includes unbounded visibility latency relative to native start. Settled or repeating dash patterns alone can admit multiple age branches. A constant recording time offset may cancel between onset and sample; no navigation offset is required or invented. Unbounded variation/unknown mapping between presented frames and native effect age remains an unverified prerequisite.
identifiabilityBarrier.existingDiagnostics: 106.93ms threshold sensitivity and 19.33ms conditional pose spread are diagnostic outcomes, not confidence intervals or proofs of a complete feasible-set width. Recording normalized residual 0.252910707268 exceeds tested synthetic 0.06684438855; averaging/intersection cannot repair missing model/error validation.
identifiabilityBarrier.sourceLimit: Locked CSS/HTML recover authored source; hash equality does not prove original recording native style, compositor behavior or effect identity. User confirms no other original-session trace/log exists.
